text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Весна) is here. Gold
City's
manager rushes to the waiting
room to check on
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her manager reminds us of Голд Сити's
promise to
quit racing if she fails to
deliver a truly
eye-catching performance
today, but this warning
only boosts Gold
City's motivation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Тамамо Кросс pays
Gold City
not even a glance. This further
fills Голд Сити with
the determination to
not be outdone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
